value: If you share your organization's documents at /contribute, Union Ground stores the organization name and optional affiliation, its state, your name, role and email address, how you want to be told the digitized forms are ready and the mobile number or mailing address you give for that, the outreach code in the link you followed if it had one, your optional note, both confirmations you check, and the files you upload, so the team can digitize the documents, make the digitized forms available to your organization's workers and reply to you. Only blank forms and documents with no worker information belong there. Every file is kept in private storage that no visitor or account can open, and is checked for malware by Union Ground's file scanner before it is accepted; a file that fails the check is not used. The mobile number or mailing address is used only to tell you the forms are ready. Nothing is sent to the address you entered when you submit. The submission stays on file until you ask for it to be removed. To have it deleted, email the contact address below.
